current.text: Utah's guard and wing rotation is crowded with Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Sensabaugh, Ace Bailey, Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. That leaves little room for him.
Experts see no real opportunity for him this season. His fantasy value is called finished after Utah drafted Peterson.
He may play 20 minutes per game at most.
His strong late-season rank last season came from Keyonte George's injury and other players sitting. Experts say he cannot repeat it.
Utah is trying to win this season and is expected to make the playoffs. The late-season minutes he got last season should not open up again.

durable.text: He scores well inside the arc but cannot shoot from outside.
